==English==
{{wp|Public housing}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun|-}}

# {{lb|en|UK}} Rental housing owned and managed by the government, non-profit organizations, or by a combination of the two, with the aim of providing affordable housing, often focusing on disadvantaged groups such as low-income earners, social-security recipients, the elderly and people with disabilities.
